gtp0_local_ip.description: Local IP address used by the GGSN for GTP-C/GTP-U (must be reachable by SGSNs).

gtp0_remote_ip.description: Remote GTP endpoint (e.g., SGSN) IP; often left as 0.0.0.0 to accept any peer.

vty_bind_addr.description: IP address for the VTY/CLI management interface (e.g., for telnet or ssh-based vtysh).

vty_port.description: TCP port for the VTY/CLI management interface.

gsup_local_ip.description: Local IP for the GSUP (Generic Subscriber Update Protocol) server interface.

gsup_remote_ip.description: Remote GSUP peer (e.g., HLR or MSC) IP.

name.description: Unique name for the IP pool.

subnet.description: IPv4 subnet (CIDR notation) for subscriber addresses.

gateway.description: Gateway IP for this pool (typically GGSN's interface IP in this subnet).

dns2.description: Secondary DNS server IP (optional; leave empty if unused).

wins1.description: WINS server 1 IP (optional, for Windows name resolution).

ip_pools.description: List of IP address pools assigned to APNs.

name.description: APN name as used in subscriber profiles (e.g., 'internet', 'mms').

pool_name.description: Name of the IP pool to assign to this APN.

qos.description: QCI / ARP / QoS parameters (e.g., '6 6 0 0 0' for best-effort).

pco.description: Protocol Configuration Options string (e.g., for DNS suffix, MSISDN, etc.).

apns.description: List of APNs served by this GGSN, each linked to an IP pool.

gprs_ran.description: GPRS Routing Area Identity (RAN) — optional but recommended for inter-SGSN handover.

ip.description: IP address of the SGSN peer (for GTP-C/GTP-U).

port.description: GTP-C port (2152 is standard for GGSN<->SGSN).

local_ip.description: Optional local source IP for GTP connections to this peer.

local_port.description: Optional local source port for GTP.

apn.description: Default APN for routing to this peer (optional).

tft.description: Traffic Flow Template filter string (e.g., 'in 10.0.0.0/8 out 10.0.0.0/8').

sgsn_peers.description: List of SGSN peers (one per SGSN in the network).

s5_s8_enabled.description: Enable S5/S8 (EPC) interface for connection to SGW/PGW. If true, configure below fields.

s5_s8_interface.description: Network interface used for S5/S8 (e.g., 'gtp0' or 'eth1').

s5_s8_local_ip.description: Local IP address for S5/S8 GTP-C interface.
